== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[Tarfful, Wookiee Insurgent (Errata)]] (GEMP <code>2272_1018</code>), showing the '''PC-E2''' game text: the errata of 13 April 2013 that added “(as if just lost)”, rescinded on 15 April 2013. Re-rendered in CardMaker: no published image of this text. The Master List slip ([[:File:VL-history-1272-18-front-master.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB7-L-tarffulwookieeinsurgent-pre.gif]]) print PC-E1 ([[Tarfful, Wookiee Insurgent]]).

* '''Text source:''' Players Committee rules forum, “Current Rulings/Errata” (t=36574), post of 13 April 2013 ([https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=36574#p802181 forum post]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20150320030739/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/forums/viewtopic.php?f=871&t=36574#p802181 Internet Archive]); rescinded 15 April 2013 ([https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=36574&start=20#p802670 forum post]). Quotes drawn as the card prints them.
* '''PC-E2 text:''' ““Occupy” on Forest Depths is treated as “control.” Non-unique Wookiees here are Heroic. Once per game, when deployed, may ‘roar’ to take one card into hand from Used Pile (reshuffle) and/or stack a Wookiee (as if just lost) from hand on Grrrghrrrgh!.”
* '''Made:''' 11 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 73) from the card's own Virtual Legacy card (<code>1272_18</code>: Decipher art of •Wookiee Roar, title •Tarfful, Wookiee Insurgent, lore “Leader.”, icons, Virtual Block 7 set mark, concept credit) with the PC-E2 game text. The red frame patch of the Players Committee card image is not reproduced. Holotable size, 745 × 1039. Rebuild spec in the batch B39 run folder.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
